name: Pan-Fried Sausage & Cabbage Fritters with Honey Mustard Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a large bowl along with shredded cabbage, flour, eggs, and spices; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
1 cup all-purpose flour
6 eggs
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, scoop the cabbage mixture into the skillet, spacing each scoop a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, dressing, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup honey mustard dressing
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide fritters and sausages between plates. Serve with sauce on the side for dipping and enjoy!
